This container configures how many EcucPartitions specific API
links are required for the LdCom Proxy and to which cluster
resource the API set belongs.
In the LdCom Low Proxy all offered API sets (incl. callbacks)
needs to be configured. In the LdCom High Proxy only the ones
are configured which are offered inside this Application Software
Cluster.
